title.narrative: Humanitarian support for vulnerable households in Kayin State

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtThis project is a partnership between Land Core Group and Ethic Women. It will meet humanitarian needs of IDPs in seven villages in Hpapun Township, Kayin State . In six of the villages the IDPs are living among host communities while in the seventh the entire community are IDPs. Taking consideration of conflict sensitivity principles, the project will also provide assistance to the most vulnerable members of the host communities. ltbrgtProject partners: Ethic Women and LCG are partners and the two organizations have experience working together since 2021 on humanitarian assistance and COVID-19 response-related projects.ltbrgtEthic Women is a women’s organization that focuses on issues facing women. It was formed in 2018 by women who had been providing awareness training since 2015 to women survivors of sexual violence and rape with support from the Freedom and Justice Women’s Network. Ethic Women’s main work has been counseling and helping women who are survivors of violence (domestic violence, rape, etc.) and related problems. It has also supported the development of law and policy to help women, IDPs, and other vulnerable groups. It works with NGOs, local CSOs, and CBOs to reduce local conflicts and to provide humanitarian assistance. Ethic Women promotes women’s participation in all processes so that women represent women’s voices and their voices are heard in their communities.ltbrgtLCG will be responsible for overall project management and accountability, reporting, donor relations, and purchase of non-food items. Ethic Women will be responsible for field implementations such as beneficiary selection process, training, delivering materials, logistic arrangement, coordination and engaging with relevant technical organizations. ltbrgtBeneficiaries: Beneficiaries consist of a total of 1,278 households (both IDPs and host communities) with a total population of 3825 including 1181 Men , 1168 Women, 729 boys and 747 girls. ltbrgtNFI support will be given to 550 IDP households (1,346 persons (431 Women, 468 Men, 200 Boys and 247 Girls) and 300 host community households (600 Men and 600 Women). In this figure, total 497 PwDs household (confirm while we collect the based line) will be provided with NFI. Regarding the IDPs community in targeted area, some of the families were displaced with whole family but some families member were displaced separately to other area. So the average number of family members per household is not the same as host community. ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtPlease see detail in comment.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgt
